maya: quick heads-up — canary harrier-int4 shows 6.8% rise in funcall JSON parse failures vs fp16 baseline over last 6h
liam: any tokenization or suffix pattern diffs? :thinking:
maya: aggregated suffixes show trailing commas + lone backslashes, e.g. `{\"action\":\"open\",\"args\":[1,2,], \\n}` — likely truncation + quant noise
sophia: matches prior int4 suffix-noise; quantized attention can clip at EOS leaving partial escapes
oliver: can we confirm via raw canary dumps?
maya: two raw excerpts:
`{\"tool\":\"create_ticket\",\"payload\":{\"title\":\"Crash on iOS 17\",\"priority\":\"hi\",},`
`{\"tool\":\"search\",\"q\":\"customer id: 123\\\\n\"`
liam: yep, truncated escape and trailing comma — model-side likely
canary-bot: harrier-int4 v2026-03-20T10:30 summary: parse_fail_rate=0.068, mean_latency=220ms, fallback_fp16=0.002
maya: proposal: staged retry flow (funcall_retry_strategy_v3): 1) lightfix regex (strip trailing commas, close simple unbalanced braces, escape lone backslashes) 2) tolerant-json-parse (accept single quotes/unquoted keys, rehydrate commas) 3) mirror-retry to fp16 shadow if still failing and retry_budget>0
oliver: concerns: deterministic fixes may mask true truncation semantics; mirror-retry doubles cost per request
liam: mitigation: run lightfix only for short outputs (token_count<150) and mirror-retry only when schema_prob>0.7
qa-runner: I'll run AB: control, lightfix-only, lightfix+tolerant, full-flow. Start at 1% traffic cohorts
sophia: add telemetry tags: parse_fail_cause={trailing_comma,broken_escape,truncation,other} and postfix_action={fixed,tolerant_parsed,mirror_retried}
maya: rollout CLI snippet:
`redwood deploy-config set funcall_retry_strategy_v3 --param \"lightfix_token_limit=150\" --param \"schema_prob_threshold=0.7\" --percent=1`
maya: QA checklist: 24h canary with 2k probe prompts across canonical tool schemas; measure false-positive acceptance where lightfix returns incorrect but parsable JSON; measure latency p50/p95 for lightfix path
qa-runner: kicking off runs now, will post 6h interim graphs to #eng-ml
canary-bot: scheduled rollout groups: lightfix_only(1%), mixed_flow(1%), control(98%). First metrics expected in ~6h
